claims.title: Claims ledger
claims.subtitle: Every substantive claim with its evidence and support level.
claims.gapNote: A claim without evidence is declared a gap; no reference is generated for it.
claims.contradictionNote: Contradictory evidence is shown, never hidden, and blocks closing the claim until resolved.

thread.title: Golden Thread Lab
thread.subtitle: From problem to recommendation, with no missing link.
thread.noProject: Select a project to view its thread.
thread.scoreNote: The score is indicative; it must not be used alone as a final verdict.
thread.gateNote: The gate opens on the absence of blocking findings, not on reaching a score.
thread.missingList: The missing elements, by name — each one blocks the gate until it is added:
thread.allPresent: The thread is complete: all nine elements are present.
thread.groupRequired: Elements whose absence blocks the gate
thread.addTitle: Add an element to the thread
thread.addNote: The addition is written to the audit log under your name, and the score is re-read from the server afterwards — the interface never computes it.
thread.scoreNotComputed: Consistency has not been computed yet: the core elements are incomplete.
thread.missingHint: Elements not yet recorded — an absence of what is checked, not a result.
thread.structuralHint: Missing links between elements that exist — these alone are consistency defects.
thread.linguisticHint: Wording that needs your review — a suggestion, not a verdict.
thread.conflictsHint: This check never sets row against row, so it cannot produce a conflict.
thread.cleanPartial: No defect was found among the recorded elements — what is not yet recorded was not checked, so this is not a certificate of consistency.

theses.title: Thesis library
theses.subtitle: Turn a thesis into independent, publication-ready research opportunities.
theses.rightsNote: The rights basis is a claim the researcher records; approval is a separate decision at gate GT1.
theses.addNote: Registration records the thesis; it grants no right: the basis of use stays a claim until the GT1 gate. Parsing a thesis requires its file to be attached.
theses.uploadTitle: Upload your thesis — PUBRIVA reads it
theses.uploadHint: PDF or Word. PUBRIVA reads the file and proposes its information; you review it.
theses.noOcr: Scanned files with no text layer cannot be read yet — there is no OCR at this stage.
theses.stateParseFailed: The document could not be read
theses.reprocessNote: Reprocessing adds new proposals; it never erases what you approved.
theses.identifiedByFilename: Title not extracted yet · shown by file name
theses.noFileNoTitle: Manually registered thesis with no file
theses.stateTextLayerMissing: The document has no text layer, and OCR is not available yet
theses.searchLabel: Search by file name or title
theses.noMatches: No thesis matches your search or the selected view.
theses.candidatesOnly: Opportunities are candidates grounded in thesis elements; none advances to publication without your review and rights and authorship approval.
theses.consentDeclined: You did not authorize external processing
theses.consentExcluded: Chunks that will not be sent (appendices or personal identifiers)
theses.consentNotRecall: Withdrawing stops future processing; it cannot recall what was already sent.
theses.consentLocalDone: Local reading and deterministic extraction are done — neither leaves the server.
theses.stateAwaitingConsent: Local reading complete · awaiting your authorization
theses.stateLocalOnly: Local reading complete · no external processing

opportunities.title: Publication map
opportunities.subtitle: Every opportunity with its readiness, overlap and gate status.
opportunities.empty: No opportunities yet. Start from the thesis library.
opportunities.overlapNote: Overlap is a review signal, not a plagiarism verdict; the decision is human.
opportunities.analysisNote: Analysing an opportunity is allowed before rights; only advancing it is not.
opportunities.noTheses: No thesis is registered yet, and the opportunity map is derived from one. Start by uploading your thesis under “My Theses”.

manuscripts.title: Manuscript Studio
manuscripts.subtitle: Build the manuscript section by section, tying every result to an analysis run.
manuscripts.gateNote: Gate G9 does not open by clicking: every unsupported claim, and every result with no analysis run, stays a blocker. The server enforces it; this screen only explains it.

analysis.title: Data & Analysis
analysis.subtitle: From raw data to interpretation, along an unbroken evidence chain.
analysis.frozenNote: Analysis runs only on a frozen dataset version, and a plan cannot be edited once locked.
analysis.harkingNote: The plan is locked before results are seen, so the hypothesis cannot be written after they appear.

trends.title: Research Radar
trends.subtitle: Watch research trends and turn them into actionable opportunities.
trends.evidenceNote: No orphan signals: every signal carries a source, an identifier and a date. Model output is recorded but never counted as evidence.
trends.twoScoresNote: Trend strength and opportunity fit are two separate scores and are never merged: a strong trend can still be a poor fit for this researcher right now.
trends.p14Note: Authorizing a submission is a human act recorded against its author; the system never submits anything externally on its own.

approvals.title: Decisions awaiting approval
approvals.subtitle: §9 gates and integrity alerts in one place.
approvals.noTimeoutNote: No gate closes by timeout: an approval waits for a human indefinitely, and the requester cannot decide their own request.
approvals.reasonLabel: Reason (required for approval and rejection alike)
approvals.reasonRequired: A decision needs a written reason — rejection as much as approval.
approvals.resolutionRequired: Resolving an alert needs a written rationale.
approvals.noDeleteNote: An integrity alert is never deleted: it is resolved with a rationale that stays on the record.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: A hash-chained event log — read only.
audit.appendOnlyNote: There is no edit or delete button here because the log itself refuses both: the privileges are revoked in the database and a trigger blocks the rest.
audit.chainBroken: Chain broken — the log was touched outside the application
audit.adminOnlyNote: This screen is for administrative roles only (§28).

settings.title: Settings and runtime posture
settings.subtitle: What the system does right now, and what it does not.
settings.readOnlyNote: This screen discloses; it does not change anything. Configuration lives in the environment, not the browser. No key is shown — only whether one is set.
settings.researcherProfileHint: Your academic identity and languages, plus candidates awaiting your confirmation.
settings.researchGoalsHint: What you intend and what limits you — an intention you measure yourself against, not a promise.
settings.profileHint: Your institution, rank, field, and ORCID.
settings.factsHint: Extracted fact candidates awaiting your approval.
settings.memoryHint: What you approved, now verified memory.
settings.agentsHint: What PUBRIVA AI can and cannot do, with its declared constraints.
settings.advancedNote: These two logs describe system execution rather than your research, and appear for administrative roles. The role is read from the server; the real boundary lives there, not in a hidden link.
settings.tracesHint: Every run with its tools, cost, and latency.
settings.auditHint: An append-only log with a verifiable hash chain.
settings.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
settings.passwordRevokesSessions: After the change every session on every device ends, and you sign in again with the new password.
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Signing you in again…

team.title: Project team and decisions
team.subtitle: Who contributed what, and what was decided when.
team.creditNote: CRediT roles are selected by hand, never suggested from your activity on the platform: suggesting them turns “who did what” from a declaration into an inference.
team.decisionHistoryNote: Superseded decisions stay visible: hiding them makes the log look as if the current view were the only one ever held.
team.noProject: No research project yet. Team and decisions belong to a specific project — start one under “My Research” first.
team.consentIsPersonal: Author consent is the author's own act: it is recorded from their account, never on their behalf. There is no “consent for everyone” button.
team.inboxNote: These items are waiting on an action now — and they are not the decision ledger: mixing the two makes it impossible to tell a pending line from a settled one.
team.emptyInbox: Nothing is waiting on an action in this project.
team.yourConsentNote: This button is yours alone: it appears because you were declared an author and your own decision is awaited. No consent button ever appears for anyone else.
team.nameOnly: Display name only, no account — cannot sign in or consent
team.consentUnverified: Legacy consent with no recorded author — it must be collected again from the person themselves.
team.invitationNote: An invitation proposes a role and grants nothing: nobody becomes a member until they accept with their own account.
team.tokenOnce: Shown once: the server stores its hash, not its text, so it cannot be shown again. Hand it only to the person it names.
team.inviteNote: The invitation goes to a platform account's email, and acceptance binds membership to the account that accepted — never to a name match.
team.joinNote: Paste the token you received. It is accepted for your account only — a valid token in someone else's hands is refused.
team.addMemberNote: Records a contributor by display name only, with no account: they cannot sign in, consent, or be attributed an action. For real collaboration, send an invitation.
team.ledgerNote: The record of what the team decided — a history to read, not a list of actions waiting.

briefs.title: Intelligence brief
briefs.subtitle: What changed in your trends and opportunities this period.
briefs.evidenceNote: Every item carries its reference. An item without one is a rumour, and the contract rejects it before it reaches this page.
briefs.emptyPeriodNote: Monitoring ran this period and found nothing worth showing — which is not the same as not running.

home.title: What do you want to accomplish?
home.subtitle: Start with an idea, thesis, paper, dataset, DOI, or link — and let PUBRIVA build the research workflow with you.
home.startPlaceholder: Paste an idea, a DOI, or a paper link…
home.routeIdle: Write your idea, or paste a DOI or a link — we tell you where it opens before it opens.
home.routeIdea: An idea — opens in PUBRIVA AI.
home.routeIdeaGated: An idea — opens in PUBRIVA AI; execution is not activated right now, and the page gives the reason and the next action.
home.routeDoi: A DOI — resolved in the reference indexes (Crossref and OpenAlex).
home.routeUrl: A link — searched in the reference indexes.
home.ideaTitle: Build a paper from an idea
home.ideaHint: From a topic to the problem, gap, question and method.
home.thesisTitle: Mine publication opportunities from a thesis

home.dataHint: From a data file (CSV or XLSX) to a grounded analysis and interpretation.
home.searchHint: Search Crossref and OpenAlex, and save what helps into your library.
home.continueHint: Pick your projects up where you left them.

ai.title: PUBRIVA AI
ai.subtitle: The research brain: it reads what you upload and proposes — it approves nothing on your behalf.
ai.placeholder: Enter an idea, upload a thesis, paper, dataset, DOI, or link…
ai.startersLabel: Or start from a ready intent
ai.gateTitle: PUBRIVA AI execution is not activated yet.
ai.gateBody: The model provider is set to none, so no model is called and no result is generated. The interface shows the path without claiming to have walked it — activation is a separate, announced stage.
ai.deterministic: What works today without a model
ai.deterministicBody: Deterministic extraction, the nine consistency checks, journal matching and readiness scoring — all run on rules, not on a model.
ai.askFailed: PUBRIVA AI could not be reached.
ai.gateUnreachableBody: We could not ask the server about the model provider — your session may have expired, or it was unreachable. Sign in and retry; we will not claim execution is disabled when we never asked.
ai.gateNextAction: What works right now without a model: search the reference indexes.
ai.uploadFailed: The file could not be uploaded.
ai.consentTitle: Asking about this document needs your permission
ai.consentBody: Only what you have reviewed and approved from this document will be sent to the AI provider to answer your question. The full file, its raw text, and anything you have not reviewed will not be sent.
ai.consentDeclined: You declined answering from this document. You can allow it any time.
ai.needsProcess: The document must be processed first
ai.needsReview: The extracted facts are waiting for your review
ai.processStarted: Processing started — follow it in your library.
ai.refSaved: The reference was saved to your library
ai.refSaveFailed: The reference could not be saved.
ai.refIndexDown: An index did not answer on this attempt, so what it holds was not shown
ai.canDoTitle: What PUBRIVA AI can do right now
ai.canDoUnknown: We could not ask the server about its capabilities — we claim neither that they are available nor that they are off while we have not asked.
ai.capSearchOn: Searches the scholarly indexes when you ask, and returns references attributed to the index that stated them
ai.capSearchOff: No reference index is enabled in this deployment, so no sources are retrieved.
ai.capFullTextOn: Reads what you approved from your uploaded documents, after processing and your consent
ai.capFullTextOff: No storage is configured, so no full text of any study exists in this deployment.
ai.capMonitoringOn: Monitors the literature on a schedule from an external registry
ai.capMonitoringOff: No scheduled literature monitoring — this does not stop reference search when you ask.

search.title: Scientific Search
search.subtitle: Find papers and import them into your library with their source.
search.gateTitle: External search is not activated yet.
search.gateBody: The literature registry is set to offline, so no external registry is called and no results are shown. What works today: manual DOI import into your library.
search.retracted: This paper is retracted — no claim may rest on it.
search.notStoredNote: These are candidates from an external registry; none is stored in your library. Importing is a separate act, performed in

references.title: Reference Discovery
references.subtitle: Enter a title, keywords, or a DOI. We ask the free scholarly indexes what they know — and attribute every number to whoever said it.
references.openAccessNote: “Open access only” also hides anything no index declared open; an absent declaration is not a closed door.
references.empty: The indexes answered and found nothing matching this search.
references.failed: The search could not be run.
references.partialWarning: One index did not answer, so what you see is incomplete — not everything that exists.
references.allDown: No index answered. This is not “no results”: we do not know today what they hold.
references.disabledTitle: External indexes are not activated in this deployment.
references.disabledBody: No external index was called, so there are neither results nor their absence. DOI import still works from your library.
references.citationsNote: Each index's citation count stays attributed to it — never summed or averaged: the two indexes count different sets.

matchBasis.title_year_author: Matching title, year, and first author

references.notStored: A search result is not a stored reference, and a stored reference is not evidence.
references.projectsFailed: Your projects could not be loaded, so adding to a project is disabled for now.
references.addedOk: Added to your project — “saved only” until you read it and decide.
references.addedState: Added to your project; its state as returned by the server:
references.savedOnlyNote: Adding does not make it evidence: it stays “saved only” until you include it yourself.
references.cannotSave: No index gives this candidate a DOI, so it cannot be stored as verified — and no identifier will be invented for it.
references.retracted: This paper is retracted — no claim may rest on it.
references.externalLinkBody: No data is collected from that platform and its page is not read. Keep the link if you wish, and search by the paper's title or DOI to reach its metadata from a scholarly index.
references.authorsUnknown: Authors not stated by the index
references.abstractLabel: Abstract as sent by the index
references.orderedByLabel: Ordered by explained relevance — not by year, and not by which index answered first.
references.noPercentNote: We show no “relevance percentage”: such a number has no unit and no referent. What we show are reasons you can check for yourself.

reasons.exact_doi: This is the identifier you searched for.
reasons.exact_title: The title matches exactly what you typed.
reasons.direct_variables: Directly related to your main variables.
reasons.context_match: Covers your full context — part of it in the abstract, not the title:
reasons.abstract_terms: Its abstract mentions some of your terms:
reasons.author_match: Written by the author you named:
reasons.recent_related: A recent study related to your topic:
reasons.highly_cited: Highly cited according to one index:
reasons.surface_similarity: Reads like your phrase but differs in subject; it lacks:
reasons.shared_terms_only: Shares some of your terms but not their context.
reasons.broader_topic: Mentions your terms inside a wider topic.
reasons.retracted: Retracted paper — no claim may rest on it.
reasons.concern: Carries a published expression of concern.

references.queryLabel: Your search, as you typed it
references.querySentLabel: What was sent to the indexes
references.queryUnchanged: Sent exactly as you typed it, unchanged.
references.understandingLabel: What we read in your search
references.suggestionsNote: These are offered, not applied: none of them has entered your search. Accept what you consider an equivalent term, reject what you consider a different construct — widening the search is your decision alone.
references.suggestionRerun: Search again with the accepted terms
references.acceptedPending: You accepted terms that have not been applied yet — search again to see them in the results.

journalsPage.title: Journals & Publishing
journalsPage.subtitle: Find a suitable journal and prepare the manuscript for submission.
journalsPage.note: The system never estimates acceptance probability and has no field for it. Matching explains its reasons.
journalsPage.publicationFitHint: Is this journal the right venue for your paper? Fifteen points out of a hundred.
journalsPage.targetTierHint: Your own target: peer-reviewed · Scopus · Web of Science · open access · no APC…
journalsPage.reasonsHint: Every criterion with its weight, ratio and reason — never a bare score.

workspace.toolsNote: These tools serve a specific project rather than the researcher at large, so they live here rather than in the persistent navigation. Their routes are unchanged.
workspace.threadHint: From problem to recommendation, with no missing link.
workspace.claimsHint: Every claim with its support, and no citation without it.
workspace.opportunitiesHint: Publication opportunities mined from theses, and their readiness.
workspace.teamHint: Members, CRediT roles, and the decision log.
workspace.approvalsHint: Approvals and alerts awaiting your decision.
workspace.briefsHint: The intelligence brief and novelty checks.

upload.title: Upload a research file
upload.hint: PDF · DOCX · TXT · RIS · BibTeX · CSV · XLSX · SPSS — up to 50 MB per file
upload.readyNote: The file is stored privately and tied to your account. **It has not been parsed or analyzed** — analysis is a separate, announced stage.
upload.gateTitle: File storage is not configured yet.
upload.gateBody: Upload is disabled until provider credentials are set on the server. This is independent of PUBRIVA AI.
upload.keepOpen: Keep this page open until the upload finishes.

review.title: Peer Review
review.subtitle: Review your paper before an editor does.
review.scientificHint: Claims, their support, and the contribution.
review.note: Review proposes patches; it never edits an approved version.

thesisReview.title: Review what PUBRIVA extracted
thesisReview.subtitle: These are proposals from your file, not approved facts. Only your approval makes them so.
thesisReview.confidenceMeaning: How clearly the text appears in the file — not a judgement on the science.
thesisReview.notExtractedHint: This did not appear in the chunks examined. Write it yourself or leave it.
thesisReview.conflictTitle: A new reading disagrees with what you approved
thesisReview.conflictBody: A later reading proposed a different value. Your approved value is unchanged.
thesisReview.cannotApproveAbsent: A field absent from the file cannot be approved: approval needs a quote to ground it.
thesisReview.statusUnknownHint: You reviewed it without deciding — you can come back to it any time.
thesisReview.knownNotClaimed: Read from the file's own metadata — a known value, not a claim awaiting your approval.

publicationPlanning.consentBody:
PUBRIVA will send only the verified information needed to build publication opportunities.
The full thesis will not be sent, and no proposal is approved automatically.
publicationPlanning.consentStale: Your evidence changed after the earlier authorization — a new one is required for the current snapshot.
publicationPlanning.consentTitle: Using AI to build publication opportunities
publicationPlanning.empty: No opportunities yet — start by building them.
publicationPlanning.evidenceReadyHint: How ready is this opportunity to be developed from available evidence? Not an acceptance likelihood.
publicationPlanning.insufficient: There is not enough verified knowledge to build a publication opportunity yet.
publicationPlanning.insufficientWhy: This is an evidence limit, not a system failure — PUBRIVA does not invent what it cannot find.
publicationPlanning.noIssues: No findings — validation is deterministic, not a model opinion.
publicationPlanning.noProjects: No projects yet — create one from My Research.
publicationPlanning.outlineNotice: A structure, not prose — writing the paper is a later stage.
publicationPlanning.proposalNotice: Title, question and contribution are model proposals — not approved facts.
publicationPlanning.providerFailed: Could not build opportunities — a processing failure, not a gap in your evidence.
publicationPlanning.question: Research question
publicationPlanning.regenerateHint: Rebuilding adds new proposals; it never erases a decision you made.
publicationPlanning.selectionRequired: Select an opportunity first to build its thread and outline.
publicationPlanning.subtitle: Turn your project's verified knowledge into specific, evidence-backed papers.
publicationPlanning.title: Publication opportunities

methods.title: Methods
methods.subtitle: Written from your verified knowledge alone — what has no evidence stays visibly missing.
methods.noEvidence: There is not enough verified knowledge to draft Methods yet.
methods.consentBody: Drafting this section sends its verified evidence to the AI provider. Your publication-planning consent does not cover this: that one authorized building proposals, this one authorizes drafting paper text that will carry your name.
methods.consentGrant: I consent to sending this section's evidence
methods.consentStale: The evidence changed since you consented — review it and decide again
methods.consentDeclined: You have not consented to drafting this section
methods.noDraft: No draft has been written yet.
methods.notice: A draft built from your verified knowledge — not approved text. Only your approval makes it so.
methods.noIssues: No blocking findings in this draft.
methods.approvedLock: This section is approved — regenerating it needs an explicit revision request.

results.title: Results
results.subtitle: A description of what was observed — no statistic appears without an analysis output behind it.
results.strictNote: Strict mode: every number in this section needs a specific analysis output. What has none is not written — however plausible it looks.
results.noOutputs: No eligible analysis outputs yet — so no statistics will appear in this section.
results.outputsNote: Eligible means: a completed run with a full reproducibility manifest and frozen data.
results.redacted: Values withheld from the evidence sent, because no analysis output backs them
results.withheld: The draft was withheld: it would have asserted content with no evidence behind it.
results.noEvidence: There is not enough verified knowledge to draft Methods yet.
results.consentBody: Drafting this section sends its verified evidence to the AI provider. Your publication-planning consent does not cover this: that one authorized building proposals, this one authorizes drafting paper text that will carry your name.
results.consentGrant: I consent to sending this section's evidence
results.consentStale: The evidence changed since you consented — review it and decide again
results.consentDeclined: You have not consented to drafting this section
results.noDraft: No draft has been written yet.
results.notice: A draft built from your verified knowledge — not approved text. Only your approval makes it so.
results.noIssues: No blocking findings in this draft.
results.approvedLock: This section is approved — regenerating it needs an explicit revision request.

studio.title: Manuscript Studio
studio.noBlockers: No scientific blockers in the current version.
studio.pendingNote: These sections need a literature search, which is not active yet. They are not written from the model's memory.
studio.selectSection: Choose a section from the list to begin.
studio.editNote: Your edit clears the approval and re-runs validation — text you wrote is not grounded because what came before it was.

project.newHint: A title is enough for now; the rest is filled in when it is known.
project.titlePlaceholder: e.g. The effect of a training programme on critical thinking
project.emptyLive: No project yet. Start one with a single title.
project.trashNote: Nothing is destroyed: a project in the trash keeps every relation, and restoring returns it as it was.
project.brainTitle: What PUBRIVA knows about your research
project.brainNote: No readiness percentage is shown: the states below are the truth, and “missing” in early research is not an error.
project.addFile: Add a file from your library
project.noFiles: No file is linked to this project yet.
project.noSources: No source in this project yet.
project.removeKeepsFile: Removing from a project never deletes the file from your library.
project.useHint: Importing a source is not a judgement that it is evidence — the decision is yours and is attributed to you.
project.notYet: This pane is not yet wired to its source; open the full tool.
project.noCandidates: No file in your library is available to add yet.
project.addSource: Add a reference from your library
project.noCandidateSources: No reference in your library yet.
project.screeningHint: Decisions live in screening: include or exclude there, and every exclusion records its reason.

screening.title: Literature screening
screening.meaningNote: “Included” means you chose it for your evidence set — not that its claims are true or that anyone verified them.
screening.queueEmpty: No study is waiting to be screened right now.
screening.emptyForTab: No study in this section yet.
screening.loadFailedNote: The server did not answer, so we do not know what this project holds. Try again.
screening.doiUnverified: This study has no verified identifier yet.
screening.retracted: This study is retracted. Read the retraction notice before building on it.
screening.reasonWhy: An exclusion with no reason cannot be reviewed a month later, nor written into your methods section. State the reason once, now.
screening.noteRequired: State the reason in words (required for “other”)
screening.reason_unrecorded_legacy: Excluded before reasons were required — no reason recorded
screening.filtersNote: Filtering happens on the server before paging, and the counts above follow it.
screening.openAccessClaim: The index declares open access — a rights claim, not text in your hands.
screening.duplicateHint: Possible duplicate: shares an identifier or title with another reference in this project.
screening.abstractsDisagree: Two indexes sent different abstracts for this study. Read both before building on them.

brain.title: Research Brain
brain.lead: What PUBRIVA knows about this project, what it does not, and what it could not read — as categories, never as a percentage.
brain.openThread: Open the golden thread for this project
brain.advisoryTitle: Advice to read, not a gate that closes
brain.hint_known: Fields backed by memory you approved, facts recorded in this project's rows, and rules that were checked and did not fire.
brain.hint_missing: Nothing backs these yet — a legitimate state early in a project, not an error to fix today.
brain.hint_needs_review: Not yet decided: extracted facts awaiting your decision, and rules that could not run and said so.
brain.hint_conflicts: A contradiction recorded in the data itself, not inferred from reading text.
brain.hint_methodological_alerts: Scientific rule violations — every one of them advisory today, blocking nothing.
brain.emptyKnown: Nothing is verified in this project yet — and that is not a verdict that it is sound.
brain.readNotesHint: These are things the platform does not store today, so they were neither checked nor guessed. Staying silent about them would let this report read as 'everything was checked and passed'.
brain.readNotesNone: Everything the platform stores about this project was read.
brain.alertMissingInfo: What is missing to complete the check
brain.alertNoEvidence: No excerpt is recorded with this finding.
brain.alertNoMissingInfo: Nothing is missing to complete this check.
brain.ruleStatus_DRAFT: Draft — no expert has reviewed it
brain.ruleStatus_EXPERT_REVIEWED: Expert reviewed — still does not block
brain.action_causality: Revise the causal language in your text, or record an experimental design that supports it.
brain.action_fabrication: Trace every number and claim back to a recorded analysis output, or remove it from the text.
brain.action_design_fit: Revisit the test's fit to your variables' scales, or record the missing scales.
brain.action_evidence: Bind the claim to evidence from sources you included by your own decision.
brain.action_provenance: Approve or reject the extracted fact — a model output is not verified knowledge.
brain.action_lineage: Freeze the data version and re-bind the run to it; lineage is read from the freeze.
brain.action_default: Open the place named above and review it.
brain.rulesUnavailable: The rule registry did not arrive, so each rule's status and provenance are not shown beside its alert.
brain.loadFailedNote: This project's assessment could not be read — what you see is not 'nothing to report': the assessment did not arrive.
brain.actionsHint: Suggestions to read; they create nothing in your project. A task is created only on your acceptance.
brain.actionsFailed: Suggested actions could not be read — what you see is not 'nothing to do'.
brain.previewTitle: Preview: this is what the task would be if you accepted it
brain.previewFailed: The preview could not be read.

goldenThread.title: Golden Thread
goldenThread.lead: The project's consistency from problem to recommendations — every line here rests on a stored row, and what has none is left blank.
goldenThread.openBrain: Open the Research Brain for this project
goldenThread.stateHint_known: A stored row joins the two ends.
goldenThread.stateHint_needs_review: Either the platform does not store this connection at all, or what would prove it is incomplete.
goldenThread.stateHint_missing: The platform does store this connection, and this project has no row for it.
goldenThread.stateHint_conflicting: Two stored rows say two different things.
goldenThread.noBasis: No stored row proves this connection, so no line was drawn.
goldenThread.emptyThread: Not one element is recorded in this project's thread yet — so no connection is checked, and this is not a verdict that it is consistent.
goldenThread.emptyConnections: No connection is shown, because the thread has no elements to join.
goldenThread.readNotesTitle: What the platform does not store
goldenThread.readNotesHint: A drawing that stays silent about what it cannot record reads as 'checked and not found'.
goldenThread.loadFailedNote: This project's thread could not be read — what you see is not an empty thread: the answer did not arrive.
goldenThread.projectTitleFallback: This project has not been named yet — the name above is a fallback, not a title you recorded.

synthesis.themesMeaning: Themes are built from the content of included studies. Title clusters are shown alongside them under their own name: they order the list; they are not a finding.
synthesis.contradictionsMeaning: A contradiction is two results disagreeing on the same constructs — not different wording and not a different topic. No study is called wrong: both results may be correct, each in its own context.
synthesis.gapsMeaning: These are observations about your current reference set only, not about the field. The system ran no systematic index search — what does not appear here may well exist outside your set.
synthesis.opportunitiesMeaning: An opportunity card is written by the researcher after approving a gap candidate. No card is generated automatically, and a card does not mean the gap has been established.
synthesis.analyzeNote: Re-runs the analysis over included studies and their matrix. Anything you already approved or rejected stays exactly as it is.
synthesis.loadFailedNote: Could not fetch the results. This is a connection state, not the state of your project.
synthesis.themesEmpty: No themes yet. Include at least two studies in screening, then run the analysis.
synthesis.contradictionsEmpty: No contradiction appeared among the included studies. The constructs and findings columns may simply not be filled in yet.
synthesis.gapsEmpty: No observation worth showing for your current set. That describes this set, not the field.
synthesis.noQuote: No textual evidence for this cell.
synthesis.approveMeans: “Approve” means: I decided to pursue this observation — not that it is established.
synthesis.rolesConsidered: References considered that neither supported nor contradicted
synthesis.notAssessedMeaning: These gap types could not be judged from the data at hand. Showing them is deliberate: a list that reports what it found and stays silent about what it could not assess reads as “nothing else here”.
synthesis.buildOpportunity: Turn it into a research opportunity
synthesis.approvedGapsMeaning: Only an approved gap can be the basis of an opportunity card. Your approval means you decided to pursue it.
synthesis.noApprovedGaps: You have not approved a gap yet. Review “Possible gaps”, then approve what you want to pursue.
synthesis.draftIsYours: You write what follows. What is shown above is read from the gap to help you; it is not ready-made wording to be adopted as is.
synthesis.projectAlreadyCreated: A project was already created from this opportunity.
synthesis.status_unknown: You reviewed it and could not decide

landing.title: Research to Publication.
landing.body: Discover the literature, build your research, manage your project, analyze evidence, write your manuscript, and get ready for publication — with AI that helps, and science that stays in your hands.
landing.threadBody: Six nodes on one thread. What you decide at one node stays legible at the next.
landing.threadFoot: Researchers today. A more open tomorrow.
landing.capabilitiesBody: No general promises: these are the screens you open once you are signed in.
landing.capBuildBody: Your research question, framework and methodology.
landing.capPublishBody: Journal selection, submission and peer review.
landing.integrityBody: Six rules that are not a slogan: each one is a behaviour in the code, checked before anything ships.
landing.integrity3: Clear distinction between suggestions and scientific facts
landing.evidenceBody: Nothing here becomes a fact without your decision. The quotation is shown verbatim with its locator before any button, a claim without evidence is declared a gap rather than given an invented reference, contradicting evidence is shown and not hidden, and every decision is recorded with its time and its author.
landing.stateLegendLabel: How the state of each item is announced
landing.stateLegendBody: Four states, each with its fixed colour — and colour never carries the meaning alone: the name of the state is written beside it, so a reader without sight, or without colour discrimination, keeps the whole meaning.
landing.stateCandidateBody: Extracted by the platform, waiting on your decision.
landing.stateReviewBody: Incomplete or unconfirmed — and you are told what is missing.
landing.stateVerifiedBody: You approved it yourself, or a stored row stands behind it.
landing.stateConflictBody: Two pieces of evidence that do not agree — both shown, and nothing closed over them.
landing.bilingualHeading: Arabic is a first language here, not a later translation
landing.bilingualBody: The whole interface reads right-to-left in Arabic and left-to-right in English, each with its own layout rather than a mirror of the other. Server messages always arrive in both languages.
landing.closingBody: An idea in one line, a finished thesis, or a paper halfway through — all of them are valid entrances.
landing.footerPromise: بحثك، مترابط من الفكرة إلى النشر.
landing.footerNote: A platform for scientific research and publication.

researcherProfile.languagesNote: The language you are reading this screen in is one thing; the language of your target manuscript is another. Changing one does not change the other.

researchGoals.title: Research Goals and Constraints
researchGoals.subtitle: A goal is an intention you measure yourself against, not a commitment the platform reads as a promise.
researchGoals.goalsNote: "Publish in a strong journal" is an intention — not a promise you are held to, and not a number anything is built on.

researchGoals.constraintsNote: What you have not stated stays unknown — it is never read as the absence of a limit.
